result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back with every promotion listing and lookup you named. The full offline suite passes (176 test classes, no failures). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: record gets a `description` component (null when none was given).
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new `createPromotion(..., category, description)` overload. The existing 5-argument method delegates with a null description, so current callers are unchanged. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category means all products.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and the six promotion queries (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period) select it and pass it to the record.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new test `keepsDescriptionWhenListedAndLookedUp` checks the text on the active, category, unused, code-lookup and best-promotion paths, and that a promotion created without one has none.

I didn't touch the demo data in `DemoScenario.java`, so the demo promotions still have no description.
